title: Twenty-four Years and One Blank Page
subtitle: 日常记录与写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常记录与写作（生活与学习·日常记录与写作）
meta: 主题语境：日常记录与写作（生活与学习·日常记录与写作）　|　核心词汇：diary　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 diary 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1944 my grandmother ① kept a diary that no one in the family would have read, and she said the keeping was the whole of the evening. The ② diary, meaning the record and not the book, ran twenty-four years and stayed unread on the shelf; a diary, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unopened.

Every ③ diary in that house had the same blank page at the end of it, and the ④ diary at the end, meaning the one she kept for the war years and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever opened twice. A diary, my mother said, is nine parts evening and one part somebody willing to write; my grandmother said the writing is the part that fills twenty-four years.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the diary was the whole of the year, meaning the book and not the record. The ⑥ diary, meaning the book and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody buys and nobody fills; diary, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a record and a book. He said the book is the part they remember.

By 1953 the ⑦ diary had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the blank page. The ⑧ diary of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one house and twenty-four years of writing; diary, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to write. She said the writing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ diary I remember is the one at the end, which was opened in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ diary, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being read; every diary, she said, is a book that has agreed to look like a record. She said the book was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 日记（指家里保存着的那一本）
B. n. 日记（指那些记录本身，与那个本子相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a diary 记日记
D. n. 日记（指留给战争年代用的那一本）
E. n. 日记；日志（抽象总称，指一屋子的记述之事）
F. n. 日记本（指清单上写到、被列出的那一本）
G. n. 日记本；记事簿（指一年里买来的那个本子）
H. n. 记事簿（抽象总称，指人人买来却无人填满的那个）

items.q: kept a diary that no one in the family would have read
The diary, meaning the record and not the book
the diary was the whole of the year
the diary had become a line in a list
The diary of the whole thing

answers.why: keep a diary 意为“记日记”，1944 年祖母记了一本家里没有人会去读的日记。
diary 意为“日记”，指那些记录本身而不是那个本子，它在书架上搁了二十四年而从未被打开。
diary 意为“日记”，指那栋房子里每一本日记，每一本末尾都有同一页空白。
diary 意为“日记”，指留给战争年代用的那一本，是唯一有人打开过两次的。
diary 意为“日记本、记事簿”，指一年里买来的那个本子，父亲说这个本子就是那一年的全部。
diary 意为“记事簿”，指人人买来却无人填满的那个而不是那些记录，是一年里人人都买来、却无人填满的东西。
diary 意为“日记本”，指清单上写到、被列出的那一本，到 1953 年这本日记成了清单里的一行。
diary 意为“日记、日志”，祖母一月写道，整件事的记述是一栋房子和二十四年的书写。
diary 意为“日记”，我记得的是末尾那一本，1972 年被打开，至今仍被说成屋里最安静的一本。
diary 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一本日记是唯一会因为被阅读而变得更好的东西。
